primitives.name: Revolving Mass Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: This play is in the nature of a revolving mass on tackle.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: M: aggregate mass of offensive unit (kg), \omega: angular velocity of the mass rotation (rad/s), r: radial distance from pivot point (m).
primitives.assumptions: The offensive line acts as a cohesive rigid body during the initial phase of the play, maintaining structural integrity under external defensive forces.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The operator fails if internal cohesion breaks down due to overwhelming opposing force, causing the mass to scatter rather than rotate coherently.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a rotational transformation matrix applied to a localized density function on the field grid.
layer2.telemetry: Measured via the collective lateral displacement and timing synchronization of the offensive linemen.

primitives.name: Reinforcement Cutoff Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Left Guard goes through, cuts off reinforcements and assists the runner.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: v_g: velocity of the Left Guard (m/s), \tau: time to intercept reinforcement (s), d: distance to secondary defensive layer (m).
primitives.assumptions: The Left Guard can accurately predict the trajectory of incoming reinforcements and possesses sufficient acceleration to intercept them before they engage the ball carrier.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the defensive reinforcement arrives faster than the guard's maximum interception velocity or if the guard misidentifies the primary threat vector.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a dynamic obstacle avoidance and path-clearing kernel within the GSE navigation mesh.
layer2.telemetry: Verified by tracking the reduction in defensive player density along the runner's projected path post-interception.

primitives.name: Hip Assistance Vector
primitives.verbatim_quote: Left Tackle comes around quickly and assists the full back on the left hip.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: F_t: applied force by Left Tackle (N), \theta: angle of approach relative to the runner's velocity vector (deg), m_fb: mass of the fullback (kg).
primitives.assumptions: The Left Tackle can synchronize his arrival with the fullback's position, applying a tangential force that maximizes momentum transfer without disrupting the runner's balance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the timing is asynchronous, resulting in a collision that impedes the runner's forward progress or causes a fumble.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a momentum injection operator in a particle physics simulation, boosting the primary agent's kinetic energy.
layer2.telemetry: Quantified by the instantaneous increase in the fullback's velocity immediately following the tackle's engagement.
